case.title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement. Need: 20000 pc a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 7 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200004. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your cost drivers. We value the years of reliable cooperation between our two family companies and want a fair solution for both sides.

Our data shows a slightly different picture:

German producer prices for bearings and gears changed +0.8% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2815@2025-08, idx:PPI-C2815@2026-08).

Your on-time delivery was 85.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70620@2026Q3).

A longer contract term gives you planning security, and the options below offer different ways to get there. Option A answers a wish for stability with a longer term, while Option C keeps your current payment terms.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.54; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.41; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.51; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

We look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your response and the proposed options. 

Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. 

We are pleased to present our updated offer at a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

We are willing to accommodate your request for a 24-month contract term with 30 days net payment to support your planning security. However, we cannot meet your target price and can offer €4.88 per unit for this configuration. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Logistics: We have free capacity for your parts. Our Lieferzeit is 7 days. With overtime we can deliver in 7 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your updated offer and for taking our delivery data seriously. We value the many years of reliable cooperation between our two family companies and want a fair solution for both sides.

We have looked closely at your position and put together three options.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.59; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.46; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.56; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

We would be glad to settle this with you as partners.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised options and your commitment to our long-standing cooperation.

For our current offer, we can propose a price of €4.91 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 60 days net, and a contract term of 24 months. 

However, we have reached the limit of our pricing flexibility for these terms and cannot offer further reductions. Please note that our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. Our standard terms apply to everything the quote does not state; see attached. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your reply and for setting out your cost drivers so clearly. We truly value the many years of reliable cooperation between our two family companies, and we want a fair solution for both sides.

We have looked again at your position and adjusted our proposal. Option A and Option B offer you faster certainty on the contract term, and Option C answers your wish for quicker payment.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.63; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.49; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.60; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

We believe this is a balanced basis for another good chapter together.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We appreciate your revised options and your commitment to our long-standing cooperation. As we have reached the limit of our pricing flexibility for a 60-day payment term, we cannot reduce the price further. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. We can, however, offer a unit price of €4.88 if you are able to accommodate a 30-day payment term. As an alternative package, this option brings a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Please note that our offer stays valid for 7 days. We are eager to continue supporting your needs with our dedicated service and extensive inventory range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached. 

It is always a pleasure to serve you with our broad range and high-standard service, and we look forward to continuing our great cooperation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
